title: Console: prod vs test API key flow + onboarding checklist validation hook
creator: Marissa Cole
description:
We need to update the API key creation + management UX in the Redwood Console to clearly distinguish TEST vs PROD keys, reduce 401s from wrong-environment keys, and provide a reliable validation signal for the onboarding checklist step "Create a production API key".

Context:
- Support ticket SUP-9244: customers frequently paste a test key into production workloads and then rotate/disable keys incorrectly, resulting in 401s and confusion.
- Guided onboarding checklist requires a step that can be (mostly) automatically validated.

Goals:
1) Make it explicit at key-creation time whether the key is for test or prod.
2) Visually label keys in the API Keys list and key details views.
3) Add a backend signal that can be used to mark checklist step completion when a PROD key is created (per project).
4) Preserve existing key behavior; this is primarily metadata + UX, not auth semantics changes in Phase 1.

Non-goals (Phase 1):
- Enforcing different rate limits/quotas by env.
- Automatic detection of "this key is used in prod".
- Dedicated/Private key flows.
acceptance_criteria: API key creation modal includes an explicit Environment choice (Test | Production) with clear copy on intended usage.
New keys persist environment metadata server-side and return it via keys list/read APIs.
API Keys list shows a visible badge for env and supports filtering by env.
Creating a Production key emits an onboarding validation signal (server-side) to complete the relevant checklist step for that project.
Telemetry emitted for key creation includes env as an allowlisted property and does not include any secret material.
Backwards compatibility: existing keys without env metadata are treated consistently (see migration decision).
Security review sign-off on UI copy + telemetry properties + retention tags.
implementation_notes:
Proposed implementation (agreed w/ Console + Control Plane):
- Data model: add nullable `environment` metadata on API key records: `test` | `prod`.
- Migration/backfill: 
  - Existing keys created prior to this change default to `prod` (to avoid implying they are "non-production" and because most existing customers are already in production). We will display a one-time inline note: "Keys created before Mar 2026 are labeled Production by default."
- Console UI:
  - API Key create modal: segmented control or radio group for environment.
  - Default selection:
    - New orgs (created after feature GA): default to Test.
    - Existing orgs: default to Production to reduce accidental behavior change.
  - Keys table: add Env column w/ badge (Test / Prod). Add filter chip.
  - Key details: show Env, created by, last used (if available), and a short explanation.
- Checklist validation hook:
  - On server-side key creation for env=prod, call checklist state update (per project) to mark step complete. Avoid relying only on client telemetry.
  - Dedupe: use idempotency key for create-key API; validation update should be idempotent.
- Telemetry:
  - Emit `onboarding.api_key_created` from backend with properties: `project_id`, `org_id`, `key_environment`, `source=console`, `is_first_prod_key_for_project`.
  - Ensure allowlist includes `key_environment`; no key prefix/secret logged.

Open questions resolved in-thread:
- Are keys project-scoped or org-scoped for checklist purposes?
  - Decision: treat checklist completion per project; if keys are org-scoped, the server hook will map the created key to the active project context used in Console when creating the key.
- Should we block creating prod keys before payment verification?
  - Decision: no for Phase 1; keep current billing gating behavior unchanged.
risk_notes:
Risks / gotchas:
- Customers might interpret Test vs Prod as hard enforcement (limits/SLA) even if it’s metadata only. Copy must be explicit: "Labels help you organize keys; behavior is the same today."
- Backfilling existing keys to `prod` could lead to over-counting checklist completion for existing orgs if we retroactively emit events. We will NOT emit telemetry for backfill; only for new create events.
- Ensure key secret is never present in URL params, telemetry payloads, or error logs.
- Permissioning: only users with existing "Manage API keys" permission can create prod/test keys; no new role introduced in Phase 1.
test_plan:
QA / test plan:
- Unit tests: API keys service model serialization includes `environment` field; create defaults behave correctly based on org age flag.
- Integration: create key via Console (test + prod), verify list badge + filter.
- Checklist: create prod key and verify step completes within expected SLA (< 10s) without requiring page refresh.
- Regression: existing org with pre-existing keys sees them labeled Production; no breaking changes in client.
- Security: verify no key secret appears in network logs, console logs, analytics events, or Sentry breadcrumbs.
rollout_plan:
Rollout:
- Behind Console feature flag `guided_onboarding_checklist` for the checklist completion UI.
- API key env labeling itself is NOT gated once backend supports it, but the default selection behavior is conditional:
  - For flagged cohorts (new orgs in onboarding beta): default key env = Test.
  - Otherwise: default key env = Production.
- Monitor:
  - Volume of create-key requests
  - 401 support contacts tagged "wrong key" (Support macro)
  - Funnel: % of new orgs creating prod key within 24h
- Rollback:
  - UI: revert default selection to Production for all cohorts.
  - Backend: keep accepting `environment` but can ignore in UI if needed (no data loss).
comments: 2026-01-24 (Marissa Cole): Creating as part of onboarding checklist build-out. Support keeps seeing 401s from users mixing keys. This needs to connect to the checklist step validation (server-side preferred).

2026-01-27 (Kaitlyn Nguyen): Initial proposal: add `environment` metadata to key model; label in keys table + create modal. Will coordinate w/ Chloe/Jada on API changes and w/ Nadia on telemetry allowlist.

2026-02-03 (Jada Williams): Backend can support `environment` as optional string enum; existing keys will backfill to `prod` during read if null (no migration job needed). Please confirm if we want to persist backfill or compute at read-time.
2026-02-04 (Kaitlyn Nguyen): Prefer persisting on write only; for existing keys treat null as prod in API response (computed). No retroactive writes. No retroactive events.

2026-02-07 (Nadia Rahman): Telemetry property allowlist update required for `key_environment`. Ensure event emitted from backend only; client event can be duplicated/noisy. Also confirm no key ID considered sensitive (ok to include internal ID; do not include any prefix/last4 if it can be used for correlation externally).

2026-02-10 (Tessa Morgan): Copy needs to avoid implying enforcement: suggest "Test (recommended while experimenting)" and "Production (use in deployed apps)" and a short note "Both key types currently have identical behavior."

2026-02-18 (Kaitlyn Nguyen): Implementation in progress. Creating prod key triggers checklist update via checklist-state service. Added idempotency handling so retries don’t double-complete steps (safe).

2026-02-21 (Leila Farouk): QA pass: env badges render correctly; filter works; checklist step completes in ~3–5s in staging. Found 1 bug: default env selection not respecting cohort flag for brand-new orgs (filed follow-up in ENG-23201).
2026-03-04 (Kaitlyn Nguyen): Merged + deployed with console-2026.03 train. Monitoring 401-related tickets and onboarding funnel. No issues observed in first 48h.
